day_open_schedule.title: Day opens (cron)
day_open_schedule.description: When the morning anchor runs. Five-field cron, in the machine's local time.

nudge_budget_per_day.title: Unrequested messages per day
nudge_budget_per_day.description: The ceiling outside the anchors. Lower is usually better. Declaring this switches the interruption budget on.

quiet_hours.title: Quiet hours
quiet_hours.description: No unrequested messages in this window. Replies are never held back.

nudge_project_cooldown_minutes.title: Minimum gap per project (minutes)
nudge_project_cooldown_minutes.description: Three separate thoughts about the same project in one hour is one interruption too many.

nudge_kind_cooldown_minutes.title: Minimum gap per kind (minutes)
nudge_kind_cooldown_minutes.description: Stops one repeating condition from filling the day's budget on its own.

stale_project_days.title: A project is stale after (days)
stale_project_days.description: Days without recorded activity before it is worth mentioning.

primary_channel.title: Primary channel
primary_channel.description: Where unrequested messages go by default.

formality.title: Form of address
formality.description: Only meaningful in languages that distinguish it.
